hints: The road remembers more than your victories.
Some classes are discovered by how you play, not only by what you choose.
Not every powerful item is meant to appear early.
Pets grow with you. Sometimes the best companion is the one you overlooked.
Some roads reveal themselves only after you have already proven you can survive them.
Echo Strike builds can become very silly. This is considered a feature.
A good defense can be an attack plan in disguise.
Artifacts are rare. The road has no sympathy.
Some secrets care about what happens between battles.
One strange build can teach you more than ten safe ones.
